identity.name: Casio MQ-24 Analog
identity.one_liner: The $15 analog quartz — the cheapest watch in the Casio catalogue, and the most-cited "just a watch" in the affordable-collecting conversation.

narrative.story: The MQ-24 is the bottom of Casio's analog line: a 35mm resin case, a mineral glass crystal, a basic three-hand quartz movement (module 536), and a 3-year battery. It is the cheapest watch Casio makes and the one most-cited when collectors discuss the minimum viable watch. The MQ-24 is the watch a collector cites when they want to make the point that a functional timepiece does not require a mechanical movement or a four-figure budget.
narrative.collector_notes: The MQ-24 has no water resistance rating beyond splash resistant. The resin strap is non-replaceable without modification. The mineral glass is unusual at this price point (most competitors use acrylic).
